description: Sets a day's answer in the signed-in user's history calendar. Three values: confirmed=true (went out, the default), confirmed=false (had usable sun but stayed in), confirmed=null (clear the answer). Defaults to today. Requires OAuth (scope history:write).

confirmed.description: true (default) the user went out; false they had sun but stayed in; null clears the answer

date.description: Day to set, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today

minutes.description: Minutes the user reports having spent in the sun (acknowledged, not stored)

name: log_sun_session
